dimensions.assessment: Directly affects the Mashpee Wampanoag Tribe and the Wampanoag Tribe of Gay Head (Aquinnah) in Massachusetts.
dimensions.evidence: authorizes leases of up to 99 years for land in the Mashpee Wampanoag Tribe Reservation and land held in trust for the Wampanoag Tribe of Gay Head (Aquinnah)

dimensions.assessment: Provides the tribes with the legal capacity to enter into long-term leases up to 99 years, comparable to other tribes under the Long-Term Leasing Act.
dimensions.evidence: authorize leases of up to 99 years for land in the Mashpee Wampanoag Tribe Reservation and land held in trust

dimensions.assessment: No federal spending, revenue, or economic appropriations are mentioned.
Makes a narrow, specific amendment to the Long-Term Leasing Act for two named tribes.
dimensions.evidence: is amended, in the second sentence, by inserting , the Mashpee Wampanoag Tribe Reservation, land held in trust for the Wampanoag Tribe of Gay Head (Aquinnah) after

dimensions.assessment: Permanently amends the leasing authority for the specified tribal lands, allowing lease agreements lasting up to 99 years.
dimensions.evidence: authorize leases of up to 99 years for land in the Mashpee Wampanoag Tribe Reservation

missing_information: Total acreage of land eligible for these leases is not stated.
Economic value of potential leases is not specified.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill authorizes two specific tribes in Massachusetts to enter into long-term leases of up to 99 years for their trust and reservation lands.
